title: #478 – Scott Horton: The Case Against War and the Military Industrial Complex
summary: Scott Horton is the director of the Libertarian Institute, editorial director of Antiwar.com, host of The Scott Horton Show, co-host of Provoked, and for the past three decades a staunch critic of U.S. military interventionism.
